ownership_boundary.note: observational hash only; concurrent manuscript owner may create a successor

new_evidence.read_scope: full five-page paper including §§3-7 and Table 1

allowed_claims: The pinned repository contains 3,972 precomputed graph paths and exactly matching metric rows; the paper reports 3,973, with the one-row difference localized to SWE-agent/DeepSeek-V3 (498 repository versus 499 paper).

Twenty-two selected graph contents match their recorded metric status, and three bundled SWE-agent raw trajectories reproduce their full-corpus graphs byte-for-byte with the pinned builder and complete parser configuration.

The graph builder obtains resolution from a separate evaluator report. Across six bundled samples, evaluator-report status matches the graph 6/6, while embedded OpenHands per-record status matches only 1/3.
Across six nested current-versus-bundled graph comparisons, 26/382 metadata/node/edge units changed and 356 remained stable; global invalidation would over-revoke those 356 units.
mandatory_limits: This is one external software-agent programme, not 3,972 or six independent research programmes.
The six-row comparison is a retrospective version-diff locality oracle, not a prospective typed-policy or ARGO efficacy estimate.
The 1,446,491,536-byte Zenodo raw archive was identified but not downloaded; full raw-corpus integrity is unverified.
Static selected graph JSON contains command and summary fields but no complete raw thought/observation/response fields.
OpenHands raw model identity versus sample graph directory is 0/3; do not make same-model or same-recipe sample/full comparisons.
Graphectory supplies recorded terminal status but no correction/reopening choice oracle, so decision correctness remains open.
suggested_korean_claim: 세 번째 외부 프로그램의 고정 저장소에서는 3,972개 그래프 경로와 지표 행이 정확히 대응했고, 표본 여섯 건의 종료 상태는 별도 평가 보고서와 6/6 일치했다. 그러나 OpenHands 원시 레코드 내부 상태는 그래프와 1/3만 일치했으며, 버전 비교에서 382개 구성 단위 중 26개만 변하고 356개는 유지되었다. 이는 결과 경로와 변환 판본 의존성을 분리해야 함을 보이는 단일 프로그램의 사후 구조 증거이지, 수정 의사결정의 정답이나 ARGO 효능 증거는 아니다.
